t: A Raspberry Pi 5 in a cooled box with a fast AI chip inside.
steps: Buy it from Seeed Studio or a store such as RobotShop.
Get a 5 V 5 A USB-C power supply and a microSD card.
Flash Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm 64-bit with Raspberry Pi Imager.
Copy the pcie-fix overlay from the Seeed wiki and turn it on in config.txt.
Install the Hailo software and run the object detection example.
Work through Seeed's Hailo tutorial repo from zero to hero.
Add an NVMe SSD and set the box to boot from it for more speed.
Try the Frigate camera recorder guide on the Seeed wiki.
meta: Open Code. From $303. A few stores.
